sloka: को ऽसौ पर्वतसङ्काशः किरीटी हरिलोचनः ।लङ्कायां दृश्यते वीर सविद्युदिव तोयदः ।। ६.६१.५ ॥
transliteration: ko 'sau parvatasaṅkāśaḥ kirīṭī harilocanaḥ ।laṅkāyāṁ dṛśyate vīra savidyudiva toyadaḥ ।। 6.61.5 ॥

translations.english: "Who is that hero resembling a mountain, a crowned one with tawny eyes, looking like a rainy cloud driven by lightning? He is seen in Lanka."
